note: Re-judged 2026-11-14 at 5d862bbab9 by an independent auditor who authored none of the changes named. RFC 7911 Section 2: "However, the Path Identifier MUST be assigned in such a way that the BGP speaker is able to use the (Prefix, Path Identifier) to uniquely identify a path advertised to a neighbor." One cited producer moved: 178cffd97d changed Session.retireWrite, which now calls recordWriteFailure where it called setCloseReason. recordWriteFailure (session_write_budget.go) still records the close reason, and when the failed write waited out the session write budget it wraps the error in ErrWriteBudgetExpired, logs and raises doctor-bgp-peer-not-reading once, and calls onWriteBudgetExpired, which stores two atomics (Peer.recordWriteBudgetClose). It takes no lock, returns on every path, and touches no identifier state. The part of retireWrite this row cites it for is unchanged and still runs after it: under adjOut.mu, adjOut.clearRoutes for the session that owns the Adj-RIB-Out, which is where a failed write gives up the identifiers that session advertised. No key is built and no identifier assigned, retained or released differently. Both tagged units are byte-identical to the recorded ones and were re-read: TestForwardPathIDsDifferForCollidingSources reads the identifier field from two destination frames of colliding sources and requires them unequal; TestForwardPathIDStableAcrossUpdates requires a repeat of one path to keep its identifier and a colliding source to differ. Neither drives a failed write, so retireWrite is a cited producer no tagged unit exercises, as before. Caveat on scope, unchanged: both units drive buildFwdBody, so they judge identifiers on re-advertised paths and not on originated routes. No test or record ran for this rejudgment. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
